data.title: 椎叶紬 · 灯下绒垫的发带挑选
data.description: 晚间房门轻掩的卧室内飘着柔和暖光，椎叶紬换上松软亲肤的浅杏色泡泡袖棉纱睡裙，赤脚跪坐在床边地毯上，面前摊开一只珍藏的丝带与发夹木盒。她拿起一条淡粉缎带在耳边轻轻比划，转头问你「戴这个会不会太像小孩子」时，脸颊透着害羞却满心雀跃的红润。
data.location: 摆着手工木盒与暖光台灯的温馨少女卧室床边
data.action: 跪坐床边地毯举起发带在耳畔比划，羞涩期待地抬头询问
data.lighting: 柔和暖黄台灯照亮浅杏棉纱碎褶与细腻神态
data.camera: 平视中景，木盒发带与少女娇柔睡姿自然融合
data.mood: 纯真、娇羞、卸下伪装后的小小幸福
data.promptProse: Kneeling on the soft rug beside her bed in front of an open wooden keepsake box, Tsumugi Shiiba holds a pastel ribbon beside her cheek to test how it looks. The soft apricot double-gauze sleep dress with puff sleeves and delicate ruffles brings out her unguarded femininity as she asks for an opinion with a shy blush.
data.animaCaption: Kneeling by an open ribbon box in her warm bedroom, she holds a ribbon near her hair with a shy blush.
data.nsfwProse: The soft translucent apricot cotton-gauze nightdress drapes lightly around her shoulders and upper thighs in the warm lamp glow.
